name: Trial of the Sea Lion

angles.text: This rite is exclusive to druids. It tests their spiritual maturity and balance before they may commune with aquatic spirits and adopt the sea lion’s form.
As long-standing custodians of Moonglade and the Cenarion Circle, night elf druids revere Dendrite Starblaze’s teachings and the sacred ground around the Shrine of Remulos.
For tauren druids newly welcomed into the Cenarion Circle, undertaking the trial in Moonglade strengthens their communion with nature spirits and deepens their ties with their night elf mentors.

aliases: trial of the sea lion quest
what is trial of the sea lion
faq.answer: Druids in Moonglade recover two pendant halves and unite them at the Shrine of Remulos. The halves represent agility and endurance, and the restored pendant is presented to Dendrite Starblaze as part of the path to Aquatic Form.
faq.q: What is the Trial of the Sea Lion?

aliases: who gives trial of the sea lion
where to start trial of the sea lion
trial of the sea lion quest giver
faq.answer: Warden Tajarri at the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade gives the trial. Initiates seek guidance from local residents, join the pendant halves near the shrine, then take the finished pendant to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven.
faq.q: Who gives the Trial of the Sea Lion quest?

faq.answer: The halves represent the sea lion’s agility and endurance. One reflects the grace and swiftness to glide through deep water; the other, the stamina and resilience for long journeys underwater. Druids must respect and embody both traits equally to master their shapeshifting arts.
faq.q: What do the two pendant halves represent?

aliases: where to find the pendant halves
pendant of the sea lion halves location
faq.answer: Initiates learn where the Half Pendant of Aquatic Agility and the Half Pendant of Aquatic Endurance are hidden by speaking with Moonglade’s residents. Local druids and villagers give clues about the distant waters where each half was lost or concealed.
faq.q: Where are the pendant halves located?

aliases: where is shrine of remulos pendant
faq.answer: The halves must be joined near the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade. The shrine’s sacred aura helps unite agility and endurance in one talisman.
faq.q: Where do you assemble the Pendant of the Sea Lion?

aliases: meaning of the sea lion trial
faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze teaches that agility and endurance must be balanced beneath the water. Speed without stamina brings exhaustion, while endurance without swiftness leaves a swimmer helpless against strong currents. Druids need both traits to embody the sea lion’s spirit.
faq.q: Why must druids balance agility and endurance?

aliases: what do you get from trial of the sea lion
faq.answer: Completing the trial earns the restored Pendant of the Sea Lion and fulfills a major trial required to earn Aquatic Form. Mastering agility and endurance gives the initiate a spiritual foundation for taking a form that can breathe and swim swiftly underwater.
faq.q: What is gained by completing the trial?

sections.body: Druid initiates in Moonglade undergo trials of attunement as they prepare to navigate Azeroth’s deep waters. The Trial of the Sea Lion follows earlier preparations in their spiritual training. Dendrite Starblaze oversees it in Nighthaven, where initiates learn to balance the sea lion’s graceful speed with its resilient stamina. Both are needed to take its form and withstand the ocean depths.
sections.title: The Path to Aquatic Form

sections.body: The trial centers on reuniting the two halves of the Pendant of the Sea Lion. One represents the sea lion’s agility as it glides through turbulent currents. The other represents its endurance, the fortitude to dive long into freezing water without faltering. Initiates seek guidance from Moonglade’s inhabitants as they search across the world for the scattered relics.
sections.title: Agility and Endurance

sections.body: Once both halves are found, the initiate brings them near the Shrine of Remulos, where they can be joined into one talisman. The shrine’s energies bind agility and endurance in harmony. The initiate then presents the restored pendant to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven. With the pendant, the druid shows readiness to embrace the sea lion aspect and awaken Aquatic Form.
sections.title: The Shrine of Remulos

summary: Druids in Moonglade seek the sea lion’s spirit through a sacred rite. They recover two scattered pendant halves for agility and endurance, then unite them at the Shrine of Remulos to prepare for Aquatic Form.
